51360451.protein: Dual specificity mitogen-activated protein kinase kinase 1
51360451.DESCRIPTION: Binding affinity to full length biotinylated 6His/Avi-tagged/Tev-fused human MEK1 expressed in Escherichia coli in presence of AMP-PNP by SPR assay
51360451.original_paragraph: For SPR studies, Escherichia coli-expressed human full-length MEK1 with an N-terminal avi tag was attached to a streptavidin-coated sensor chip following biotinylation. Compounds were diluted from either 10 or 100 mM DMSO stocks to obtain a top concentration of 100 or 1000 ŒºM. 3-fold serial dilutions were then made to obtain 7 or 10 dose‚Äìresponse series. AMP-PNP (1 mM) was added to each well when determining affinities in the presence of AMP-PNP. [From PMID 33603979 supplementary]: A streptavidin-coated sensor chip (GE Healthcare) was docked into a Biacore T200 or S200 instrument. The running buffer was 50 mM HEPES pH 7.4, 150 mM NaCl, 10 mM MgCl2, 0.005% (v/v) Tween20, 5 mM DTT. The surface was prepared by an initial wash with 50 mM NaOH/1 M NaCl. Full-length biotinylated MEK1 at a concentration of ~1 µM was then injected over flow-cells 2 and 4 (leaving flow- cells 1 and 3 for reference subtraction) with a contact time of 300-600 sec at a flow-rate of 10 µl/min. Typical immobilization levels were 6000-8000 response units (RU). As a last step, PEG-biotin was injected over all flow-cells to saturate remaining streptavidin sites. Compounds were diluted either from 10 mM or 100 mM DMSO stocks to obtain a top concentration of 100 µM or 1000 µM. 3-fold serial dilutions were then made to obtain 7 or 10 dose-response series. 1 mM AMP-PNP was added to each well when determining affinities in the presence of AMP-PNP. Surface activity was monitored by including the reference compound binimetinib first and last in each run. The assay was typically stable over several days at room temperature. Data were analyzed using GeneData software and Kd values determined using steady-state fits.
